recap.analyst:
Ridgeview beat Thames Rovers 1-0. On expected goals it finished 0.54–0.32: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Ridgeview had 56% of the ball. Pass completion RID 81% (149/185), TRV 76% (142/188). Shots 6–3, on target 1–0.

Ridgeview started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Thames Rovers in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: TRV to 4-2-3-1 at 65' (chasing the game); RID to 5-4-1 at 79' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 38': Ridgeview broke the deadlock through P. Petit. The chance was worth xG 0.07 (about 7 in 100 go in), struck at 85 km/h. Score now RID 1-0 TRV. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: T. Ekström completed the most passes (36); T. Arbeloa hit the top speed (33.4 km/h); N. Fofana covered the most ground (6.07 km, a 17.6 km per-90 pace); G. Brandão won the most challenges (14).

Discipline: fouls 3–4, yellows 1–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: partly cloudy, 29°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Castellana Arena, Madrid. P. Petit broke the deadlock in the 38th minute. Thames Rovers pushed for a way back, switching to a 4-2-3-1 in the 65th minute, but Ridgeview held firm. The hero: P. Petit, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Ridgeview celebrate in front of their fans.
